title: Riot X Nic Salts Mango & Blackcurrant Gelato 10ml E-Liquid
description: Mango and Blackcurrant Gelato by Riot X is a rich and fruity blend that fuses tropical Mango with the tang of juicy Blackcurrants, smoothed over by a creamy Gelato base. The result is a vibrant vape with bold fruit flavour up front and a mellow dessert finish that lingers. This e-liquid is made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine formulation, which combines freebase and nicotine salts to deliver quick satisfaction and a smooth, tactile throat hit. With a 50VG/50PG blend, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) kits including pod systems and vape pens. Each flavour in the Riot X range features double-concentrated flavour blends, offering the intense taste experience found in disposable-style e-liquids — but in a reusable format that offers more value and flexibility. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
